design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER, task 0 of title_and_registration (M=2).

STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0): {"task": 0, "key": "env_0041_online_used_car_retailer/title_and_registration/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}. --tasks 2 also showed task 1 drawing 3 prerequisite problems and factor counts [4, 5, 4, 5]. Assignment: the root title_ext_extension_tag_validity takes 6 factors, the prerequisite title_ext_shortage_cure_share takes 5.

SCOPE SNAPSHOT: occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: title_ext_shortage_cure_share (user tool pay_title_fee_shortage_f6fcb150, event title_state_fee_collected after a fee-shortage return) and title_ext_extension_tag_validity (agent tool issue_title_extension_tag_53dbe274, events title_temp_tag_issued/title_temp_tag_recorded). Left for task 1 (3 prerequisite problems): the late-penalty side of a state return (collecting a penalty the state names without an amount, reimbursing Kestrel's share of it), the lien-correction charges, and resubmission with remittance (title_submitted_to_dmv/title_state_fee_remitted) plus title_reimbursement_paid; none of these events or tools is touched here, so task 1 keeps an independent four-problem tree (penalty payment, lien charges -> resubmission -> penalty reimbursement).

WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller only wants another temporary tag. The published policy for the extension says its validity is fixed only after the buyer's cure share of the state's stated shortage stands collected; the ledger shows a 2026-10-01 fee_shortage return of 44.80 with no collection after it, so the agent must first work out the buyer's cure share (5 rules over the title ledger, the delivery appointment and the purchase ledger), hand the buyer her own payment, and only then size the extension (6 rules over turnaround, cure status, lender, handover, extension limits and carry-over). Difficulty comes from discovering the hidden prerequisite and reconciling dates across three products, not from tool choice: there is one tool per problem.

DESIGN THESIS: surface goal 'another temporary tag' -> prerequisite (state form) 'cure share stands collected' -> cure share computation (allocation of the wait between buyer and Kestrel) -> buyer pays 22.85 -> extension validity 59 days -> terminal: tag sequence 3, expiry 2026-12-04, extensions used 2, held fees 22.85. Depth: 2 problems in a chain. Breadth: title ledger (documents, remittances, returns, tags), delivery appointment and its ledger (miss cause, first slot, missed-appointment fee), purchase order (program, handover), purchase ledger (outside lender posting), service tier parameters and the GA state extension maximum.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root title_ext_extension_tag_validity <- title_ext_shortage_cure_share. Edge kind value_input, gate binding extension_cure_days, form state, prerequisite sentence: 'An extension tag's validity is fixed only after the buyer's cure share of the shortage stated on the order's most recent fee-shortage return stands collected on the order as its own fee entry.' Four-point test: (1) ordering connective 'only after', affirmative direction (a dealer states what a figure is fixed after), rewritable as 'is not fixed until ... stands collected' with nothing added; (2) its waited-on side is a record-visible state (the cure share, booked as a registration-fee entry, collected on the order on or after the fee-shortage return); (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) scope exactly the condition (collection on or after the most recent fee-shortage return). Exactly one write in this difficulty books a fee collection against a fee-shortage return: the cure-share policy's payment (the lien-charge and penalty payments of task 1 answer other return kinds and their own sentences). Derivation: sentence + ledger (fee_shortage return d96f7e01-413b-45a8-a84e-675c91d34fdd on 2026-10-01, latest collection 2026-07-29) + the cure-share rule ('the buyer's cure share of the stated shortage is collected from the buyer as its own entry') -> the buyer's cure payment. Resolving action pay_title_fee_shortage_f6fcb150, owner user (the buyer pays in person). Unmet at opening: title_transactions.d96f7e01-413b-45a8-a84e-675c91d34fdd.reject_code=fee_shortage, txn_date=2026-10-01; latest collection ed4761a0-2241-424a-be8d-79d8eacf0584.txn_date=2026-07-29; title_orders.state_fees_held=0.0. Topological order: cure share, then extension. Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping the payment gives valid_days 55 instead of 59 (check_compute value_input test passes). user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: payment (subject title_state_fee_collected): title_service_fees.collect_state 'A state fee is collected only on an order whose status is awaiting_documents or rejected; after a fee-shortage rejection the stated shortage is collected as its own entry within the fee shortage collection days.' -> status rejected (title_orders.status), return 2026-10-01 + 7 collection days = 2026-10-08 >= 2026-10-06. The clause about collecting the stated shortage is superseded by the declared overwrite (buyer's cure share collected, Kestrel funds the rest), which also retires the gate formally; it is still evidenced. title_agg_household_fees: per-order fees, single order. Extension (subjects title_temp_tag_issued/recorded): title_temp_tags.tag_state (status rejected is allowed), before_tag_expiry (time gate: anchor title_orders.temp_tag_expires_date 2026-10-08, relation not_after, duration params.extension_after_expiry_days = 0, calendar days, inclusive; frozen 2026-10-06 <= 2026-10-08; 2026-10-08 itself passes, 2026-10-09 fails). Inherited prose: lead window 7 days (opens 2026-10-01), documents complete (all four required documents received, status not awaiting_documents), extensions used 1 below min(service 2, GA 2) = 2, current tag expires before registration is expected (order rejected, not registered).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target title order 7a62f6a4-aaa8-4455-88fb-8742069bfd4b (single order of customer 87d2186c-277b-4b92-b0c0-1e8d5194040c, purchase order 1a29f9d7-5b69-4e9f-9be1-99205d5dcef5). Shortage object: the most recent fee_shortage return d96f7e01-413b-45a8-a84e-675c91d34fdd (44.80); the earlier lien_information_error return 843d8cd2-45fc-49be-9250-3f2b65b42188 is counted only as a return, never as a shortage. Remittances 5cf67217-4ccb-435b-a43f-1dafbd6bc9ff/70aee372-9feb-4af9-a599-fd260598a148 settle the opening fees 9c458e39-f6ed-4bd5-ad33-b3f8c1f6151b/ed4761a0-2241-424a-be8d-79d8eacf0584 (source_txn_id), so held fees were 0.00 before the cure. Tags: 266cdbde-bee3-4797-b5f1-a009f9e419c4 (sequence 1, defines the original validity 30) and debff42c-3db9-484b-bc57-9557b00df8d1 (sequence 2, current, matches title_orders.temp_tag_number GA-T448317). The payment carries title_order_id; the tag carries title_order_id and its own sequence.

FACTOR CARD (title_ext_shortage_cure_share, 5; round 4): cure_cost_allocation (method, multi-source) both late -> share 3/5; baseline share 1 -> 38.08. buyer_document_clock (method, multi-source; reads the delivery appointment, not counted as cross-difficulty) buyer missed the first slot 2026-08-04 (customer_unavailable; the missed-appointment fee 99.00 the delivery charter bills for a customer miss is on the appointment ledger) -> start 2026-08-04; baseline opening date -> 9 late days -> 31.16; near-miss: the actual handover 2026-08-20 is NOT the start because the miss was the buyer's. kestrel_handling_clock (method, cross-difficulty purchase, multi-source) tier 'the handover came after the latest document and no outside lender's proceeds were posted after it' -> start 2026-08-20; baseline latest document 2026-08-17 -> 14.28; near-miss: the outside lender posting f4b53bdd-8c8b-40ec-bffe-15b89ce65536 (2026-08-03) is before the latest document, so the lender tier does not apply. program_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty purchase) Kestrel Certified -> 0.05; baseline 0 -> 24.19. returns_relief (parameter) two returns -> 0.10; baseline 0 -> 25.54. Whole baseline 44.80. Gold 22.85.

FACTOR CARD (title_ext_extension_tag_validity, 6; round 4): turnaround (parameter) 23 days -> 7, baseline 50; cure (parameter) cured fee shortage on the most recent return date -> 3, baseline 55; lien (parameter, cross-difficulty purchase) outside lender -> 5, baseline 53; handover (parameter, cross-difficulty purchase) 22 days > 14 -> 3, baseline 55 (ladder now more than 14 / 8-14 / within 7, because every program requires at least one day between signing and handover, so 'handed over on the opening date' could never occur); last-tag stretch (method: x1.25 rounded up / x1.1 rounded down / untouched) 18 -> 23, baseline 54; carry-over share (parameter) 6 days x 1 -> +6, baseline 53. Whole baseline 30. Cap 60 does not bind. Gold 59.

SEED ROWS AND WHY (round 4, checked against blueprint/products/purchase.yaml and delivery.yaml): customer; purchase order (Kestrel Certified, reserved 2026-07-25 with the 500.00 deposit, hold to 2026-07-30 = 5 hold days, signed 2026-07-29 inside the hold, handover 2026-08-20, sale final and completed 2026-08-28 = the first day after the 7-day window, balance 0.00); seven purchase ledger rows: deposit 500.00 (debit card, reserved), deposit applied at signing, vehicle price 24,375.00, GA documentation fee 599.00, sales tax 1,706.25 stated on the agreement, down payment 3,000.00 by debit card (card money 3,500.00 within the 5,000.00 cap, debit lead 0 days), outside lender proceeds 23,180.25 on 2026-08-03 (5 days after signing, within the 10 funding days, while the order was contracted and before the first dispatch); charges 26,680.25 - 500.00 - 3,000.00 - 23,180.25 = 0.00, so the order was ready for handover from 2026-08-03. Delivery appointment (Local Home Delivery, booked for 2026-08-04 = 6 days after signing, lead 2; dispatched and missed with nobody home, customer_miss_count 1, reschedule_count 0 because a rebooking after a miss is not a customer reschedule; rebooked for Thursday 2026-08-20 at least 2 days after the miss and within the 14-day horizon; completed 2026-08-20) and its ledger (missed-appointment fee 99.00 billed 2026-08-04 and paid 2026-08-20, condition report no_issues at handover). Title order (rejected, tag GA-T448317 to 2026-10-12, one extension, submitted 2026-09-08) and 13 title ledger rows (2 opening fees, 4 documents, 2 tags, 2 remittances 2026-08-27, lien return 2026-09-02, fee-shortage return 2026-10-01). Automatic clauses: nothing held, no tag lapses before 2026-10-12, not registered, no other obligation lit.

PERSONA: Imani Thorsby, hurried and warm, volunteers only the goal (another temporary tag, current one ends next Monday 2026-10-12) (round 2: she no longer mentions that the state sent the paperwork back; if asked why the plates are late she has no idea). Identity (4045554826, 1990-02-17, 4573, 30318, imani.thorsby@gmail.com) only when asked. Passive reactions: agrees to pay when the agent explains a payment is needed and tells her the amount, makes the payment herself for exactly the stated amount when handed over, does not question the amount, prints the tag from her account, ends when told the tag and its expiration. She never raises a payment herself and never corrects the agent.

REACHABILITY: all inputs come from find_title_orders, find_title_transactions, find_purchase_orders, find_purchase_transactions, find_delivery_orders and find_delivery_charges; the payment amount is computed by the agent and stated to the buyer; the buyer's call returns the receipt into the shared transcript; the tag tool returns the tag number and expiration. Everything happens at frozen_time 2026-10-06 10:20 EDT; no external event is waited on.

STANDARD SOLUTION: locate (phone) -> verify (phone, DOB, SSN last4) -> read title order, title ledger, purchase order, purchase ledger, delivery appointment and its charges -> read the extension policy, see its prerequisite sentence, see the uncollected fee-shortage return -> compute the cure share 22.85 -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool + buyer's call_user_discoverable_tool(amount 22.85) -> recompute on the new ledger: the cure allowance is 3 -> unlock + call issue tag (valid_days 59).

VERIFICATION RUN (round 4; runnable entry: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py <diff> --task 0): COMPUTE OK; title_ext_shortage_cure_share = 22.85 (baselines 38.08/31.16/14.28/24.19/25.54, whole 44.80); title_ext_extension_tag_validity = 59 on the world after step 9 (baselines 50/55/53/55/54/53, whole 30); without step 9 it is 55. Other per-task gates OK (EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY with 12 actions, SOLVABILITY, GROUNDING, SCOPE).

CLOSURE: title_ext_shortage_cure_share -> pay_title_fee_shortage_f6fcb150 -> computations[0] step 9 amount 22.85; title_ext_extension_tag_validity -> issue_title_extension_tag_53dbe274 -> computations[1] step 11 valid_days 59. Topological order equals the write order (9 before 11). required_documents equals charter_scope.extended_policies.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT (compute/expected masked): reading only the two policies' prose, the tool docstrings, the five finder returns and the persona, the same order, the same two writes in the same order and the same values (22.85 and 59) follow; the only judgement points (which clock start applies, whether the cure is in) are decided by record values (customer_unavailable, a handover 2026-08-20 after the latest document, a 2026-10-06 collection).

REVISIONS: (1) symptom check_extended flagged a module-level helper as an unnamed task tool -> root cause the gate treats every function in task_tools.py as a tool -> moved the calendar arithmetic into the extension tool body -> EXTENDED OK. (2) symptom: persona DOB written in words would fail the verbatim credential check -> wrote it as 1990-02-17 -> SOLVABILITY OK.

ROUND 2 (audit audits/policy_task/title_and_registration, items for task 0 and charter): T0-C1 (RED) symptom: the persona volunteered that the state had sent the paperwork back, pointing at the record the prerequisite rests on -> root cause: an unnecessary observed fact in user_scenario -> change: sentence removed; she now answers 'no idea' if asked why plates are late; no_user_hint rewritten -> re-run: GROUNDING OK, SOLVABILITY OK. T0-O1: 'your part / your share / sounds high' removed; she is told 'the amount' and does not question it. T0-F1 / G-F1 (RED): extension_last_tag_stretch now changes the algorithm per tier (x1.25 rounded up / x1.1 rounded down / untouched) and extension_carry_over was relabelled as the parameter factor extension_carry_over_share (1 / 0.5 / 0); the scored value moved from 54 to 55 (22.5 now rounds up to 23), skipped-edge value 50 -> 51, tag expiry 2026-11-29 -> 2026-11-30; propagated to computations[1], step 10 argument and tracing, solvability business_effect, prerequisite_closure. G-O4: the cure allowance and the edge condition now require a registration-fee entry (the form the cure share is booked in), not any fee. G-O8: the cure allowance looks at all returns dated on the most recent return date, a fee-shortage return there counting first; compute uses fee_shortage_on_latest / document_return_on_latest instead of LATEST(reject_code). G-R1 (charter RED): the cure-share rule now says the rest of the stated shortage is Kestrel's own cost (no resubmission timing), and the resubmission policy adds 'Kestrel tops up the remittance for a stated shortage' (MX(0, stated - held)); on this world after the cure the resubmission would remit 60.80 = 22.85 held + 21.95 top-up + charges, so both readings agree; task 1's top-up is 0.00 (its return states 0.00). G-O1/G-O2: the cure-share policy also declares the base title_rejections clause 'fee_shortage by collecting the stated shortage' superseded, its replacement names returns that state an amount, and its rule now says a 0.00 return is not a stated shortage. G-O5: 'in full' removed from the baseline sentence; fall-through reads 'the cure share is one'. G-O6/T0-O3: buyer_document_clock cross_difficulty set to null (delivery is claimed by no difficulty); the task's cross-difficulty floor is met by kestrel_handling_clock, program_relief, extension_lien_allowance and extension_handover_allowance (purchase). G-O7: the resubmission tool's docstring and rule now say the returned order is made ready again and submitted in one action (not in this task). G-O9 (lien policy, task 1).

ROUND 3 (audit revision_2; task 0 passed round 2 and its scored values are unchanged at 22.85 and 55): G2-R1: the round-2 note above describing the resubmission top-up as MX(0, stated - held) is superseded. The resubmission policy now adds 'the rest of the stated shortage', i.e. the stated shortage less the buyer's cure share collected for it as a registration-fee entry on or after the return, and only when no remittance has been made since that return. On this world after the cure this is 44.80 - 22.85 = 21.95, the same amount the cure-share rule calls Kestrel's own cost (a hypothetical resubmission would remit 60.80). Not part of this tree. G2-O1: the cure-share policy's rule and both overwrites now carry the one sentence shared verbatim with the late-penalty policy: 'Within the service's fee shortage collection days after a fee-shortage return, the buyer pays, as its own entry, either the buyer's cure share of the stated shortage when the return states an amount or the late-registration penalty when the return states no amount; the rest of a stated shortage is Kestrel's own cost.' Change: the lender posting moved to 2026-08-03 (inside the 10 funding days, before the first dispatch) for 23,180.25 after adding the 1,706.25 sales tax charge the agreement-charges rule posts at signing; hold expiration corrected to reservation + 5 = 2026-07-30; the buyer-missed first delivery 2026-08-04 now carries its 99.00 missed-appointment fee (paid 2026-08-20) and a condition report, reschedule_count 0; handover moved to 2026-08-20 with sale final 2026-08-28; the late document is the proof of residence (2026-08-17), the insurance card arrived 2026-08-03 before the first slot. The extension handover ladder's fall-through 'handed over on the opening date' was unreachable (every program requires 1 day between signing and handover) and is now 'within seven days'. The extension becomes 59 days to 2026-12-04 (turnaround 23 days, handover 22 days, carry-over 6 days); skipped-edge value 55. Every cross-category row now follows its own charter: reservation, hold, signing, charges, card cap, debit lead, funding window, ready-at-dispatch, delivery lead and horizon, miss fee, rebook lead, handover and sale finality. user_scenario:
You are Imani Thorsby, a 36-year-old pharmacy technician in Atlanta who bought a 2021 Mazda CX-5 Touring online from Kestrel Auto this summer and had it delivered to your home. You are calling because the temporary tag on the car runs out next Monday and your permanent plates still have not come; you need another temporary tag so you can keep driving to work, and you are happy for the agent to set that up for you today. You speak warmly but a little hurriedly because you are on a short break, and you do not like being passed around.
You give your details only when the agent asks for them: your mobile number is 4045554826, your date of birth is 1990-02-17, the last four of your Social Security number are 4573, your home ZIP code is 30318, and your sign-in email is imani.thorsby@gmail.com. You do not have any order or reference numbers handy, and you say so if asked. If the agent asks about the car or the purchase, you explain that it is the CX-5, that you signed the paperwork at the end of July, that the first home delivery on August 4 fell through because you could not be home (you paid the missed-delivery fee) and it came on August 20 instead, and that your credit union paid for the loan part. If the agent asks why your plates have not come, you say you have no idea, nobody told you anything. If the agent asks how you want the new tag, you say you will print it from your Kestrel account.
If the agent tells you that a payment has to be made on the registration before the new tag can be issued and tells you the amount, you say that is fine as long as it gets the tag sorted, and when the agent hands the payment over to you, you make the payment yourself for exactly the amount the agent told you on your title and registration order. If the agent only asks whether you agree to pay, you say yes and wait for them to hand it to you. You do not question or bargain over the amount. You never bring up any payment, fee or shortfall yourself.
Once the agent tells you the new temporary tag has been issued and gives you its expiration date, you thank them and end the call. If the agent says no tag can be issued, you ask once what you can do and then accept the answer and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's Kestrel profile from the mobile number she gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by the customer reference number this lookup returns; identity must also be verified against this profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three matching profile details before any order is discussed or changed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any order, payment or tag is acted on; three details meet the tool's threshold.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the title and registration order: service type, registration state, status rejected, lienholder, current tag and its expiration, extensions used, most recent submission date and state fees held.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The extension's eligibility (status, current tag expiration, extensions used) and its validity inputs (submission date, current tag expiration, registration state, service type) come from this row; the cure payment's target order and its document due days come from it too.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the order's whole ledger: fees collected and remitted (2026-08-27), documents received with dates (latest: proof of residence 2026-08-17), tags issued with their sequence and expiration, and the state returns (lien information error on 2026-09-02; fee shortage stating 44.80 on 2026-10-01).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the shortage stated on the most recent fee-shortage return is not yet collected (the prerequisite sentence 'An extension tag's validity is fixed only after the buyer's cure share ... stands collected'), and supplies every history input: stated shortage, latest document date, latest remittance date, returns count, original tag validity, state turnaround.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the purchase order: vehicle program Kestrel Certified, signed 2026-07-29, handover date 2026-08-20, sale final 2026-08-28.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The program relief of the cure payment, Kestrel's handling clock and the extension handover allowance rest on this row (cross-difficulty purchase).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the purchase order ledger, including the outside lender's proceeds posted 2026-08-03, five days after signing and before the first delivery slot.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Kestrel's cure handling clock and the extension lien allowance rest on whether and when an outside lender's proceeds were posted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the delivery appointment: first scheduled 2026-08-04, missed because the customer was unavailable, rebooked and completed 2026-08-20.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The buyer's cure document clock starts on the first scheduled handover date because the buyer missed it; without this row the clock would fall back to the opening date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the appointment ledger: the 99.00 missed-appointment fee billed for the 2026-08-04 customer miss and paid 2026-08-20, and the 2026-08-20 handover condition report.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms that the first-slot miss was the buyer's (a missed-appointment fee is billed only for a customer miss), which moves the buyer's cure document clock to the first scheduled date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the buyer's own fee-shortage payment and hand it to the buyer.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the customer's own write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The buyer pays her cure share of the stated fee shortage on her title and registration order; held state fees rise to 22.85.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: title_ext_shortage_cure_share computes the amount; the extension's validity waits on this cure share standing collected.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.title_order_id: Value 7a62f6a4-aaa8-4455-88fb-8742069bfd4b. Basis: the Id-class docstring line 'the reference number of the buyer's title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call', and the only title order find_title_orders returns for this customer (initial_state.title_orders.7a62f6a4-aaa8-4455-88fb-8742069bfd4b). Uniqueness: the customer holds one title order; no other id is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 22.85 = RND(44.80 x 0.6 x (1 - (0.05 + 0.10)), 2). Stated shortage 44.80 = latest fee_shortage return (2026-10-01). Buyer's cure document clock: delivery first scheduled 2026-08-04 missed by the customer (customer_unavailable, missed-appointment fee billed) and after opening 2026-07-29, so the clock starts 2026-08-04; latest document 2026-08-17 -> 13 days - 10 due days = 3 buyer cure late days (baseline opening date would give 9). Kestrel's handling clock: the outside lender posted 2026-08-03, before the latest document, so the lender tier does not apply; the handover 2026-08-20 came after the latest document 2026-08-17 and no lender posting followed that document, so the clock starts 2026-08-20; latest remittance 2026-08-27 -> 7 - 5 = 2 Kestrel cure late days (baseline from the latest document gives 5). Both late -> cure share 3/(3+2) = 0.6 (baseline whole shortage 1). Program Kestrel Certified -> relief 0.05; two returns on the order -> relief 0.10; 1 - 0.15 = 0.85. 44.80 x 0.6 x 0.85 = 22.848 -> 22.85.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the extension temporary tag tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Issue the second extension tag (sequence 3) valid 59 days from 2026-10-06, i.e. to 2026-12-04, and record it on the order.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: title_ext_extension_tag_validity computes valid_days on the world after the cure share is collected.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.title_order_id: Value 7a62f6a4-aaa8-4455-88fb-8742069bfd4b. Basis: the Id-class docstring 'the reference number of the title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call'; the single title order of this customer. Uniqueness: no other order exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.valid_days: 59 = MN(2 x 30, 30 + 23 + 6). Base validity = max(service extension validity 30, original tag 2026-08-20 -> 2026-09-19 = 30) = 30. Turnaround: most recent submission 2026-09-08 to most recent return 2026-10-01 = 23 days > 14 -> 7. Cure: a fee-shortage return is dated on the most recent return date 2026-10-01 and a registration-fee entry (the 22.85 cure share) is collected 2026-10-06 -> 3 (0 before the cure). Lien: outside lender proceeds posted -> 5. Handover: 2026-07-29 -> 2026-08-20 = 22 days > 14 -> 3. Stretch (method): tags on order 2 >= lower limit min(service 2, GA 2) = 2 and the order was returned -> 18 x 1.25 = 22.5 rounded UP to 23.
